name: TTS Voices
description: Read-aloud voices from cloud and local TTS engines: ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Kokoro, Piper, LocalAI…).
author: ReadAware

settings.label: Voice
settings.helperText: ElevenLabs voice id, Fish Audio reference id, or the voice name for OpenAI / custom endpoints (e.g. alloy).

settings.label: Model
settings.helperText: Optional. E.g. eleven_multilingual_v2, speech-02, tts-1, kokoro.

settings.label: Custom endpoint
settings.helperText: For the custom provider: an OpenAI-compatible speech URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8880/v1/audio/speech.
